endangerment.comment: Fulfulde, Nigerian (fuv-fuv) = 3 (Wider communication). The Fulani people were widely dispersed across the Sahel and West Africa, and arrived in Nigeria during the 15th century. Fulfulde became dominant across West Africa during British colonial rule in the 19th century. Used in religion, poetry, literature, education, trade, and agriculture.
